017
018import java.util.List;
019import java.util.Map;
020import java.util.Objects;
021import java.util.Set;

025import java.util.function.Predicate;

038/**
039 * A utility for working with <dfn>bean types</dfn>.
040 *
041 * @author <a href="https://about.me/lairdnelson" target="_top">Laird Nelson</a>
042 *
043 * @see #beanTypes(TypeMirror)
044 *
045 * @see #legalBeanType(TypeMirror)
046 */
047public final class BeanTypes extends Types {
048
049
050  /*
051   * Static fields.
052   */
053
054
055  private static final Logger LOGGER = System.getLogger(BeanTypes.class.getName());
056
057
058  /*
059   * Instance fields.
060   */
061
062
063  // TODO: is this cache actually worth it?
064  private final Map<TypeMirror, BeanTypeList> beanTypesCache;
065
066
067  /*
068   * Constructors.
069   */
070
071
072  /**
073   * Creates a new {@link BeanTypes}.
074   *
075   * @param domain a {@link Domain}; must not be {@code null}
076   *
077   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code domain} is {@code null}
078   */
079  public BeanTypes(final Domain domain) {
080    super(domain);
081    this.beanTypesCache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
082  }
083
084
085  /*
086   * Instance methods.
087   */
088
089
090  /**
091   * Returns a {@link BeanTypeList} of {@linkplain #legalBeanType(TypeMirror) legal bean types} that the supplied {@link
092   * TypeMirror} bears.
093   *
094   * <p>The returned {@link BeanTypeList} may be empty.</p>
095   *
096   * @param t a {@link TypeMirror}; must not be {@code null}
097   *
098   * @return a {@link BeanTypeList} of {@linkplain #legalBeanType(TypeMirror) legal bean types} that the supplied {@link
099   * TypeMirror} bears; never {@code null}
100   *
101   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code t} is {@code null}
102   *
103   * @microbean.nullability This method never returns {@code null}.
104   *
105   * @microbean.idempotency This method is idempotent and returns determinate values.
106   *
107   * @microbean.threadsafety This method is safe for concurrent use by multiple threads.
108   *
109   * @see #supertypes(TypeMirror, java.util.function.Predicate)
110   */
111  public final BeanTypeList beanTypes(final TypeMirror t) {
112    // https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.0/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.0#assignable_parameters
113    // https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.0/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.0#legal_bean_types
114    // https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.0/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.0#managed_bean_types
115    // https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.0/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.0#producer_field_types
116    // https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.0/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.0#producer_method_types
117    final Domain d = this.domain();
118    return switch (t.getKind()) {
119    case ARRAY -> 
120      this.beanTypesCache.computeIfAbsent(t, t0 -> BeanTypeList.of(d,
121                                                                   (legalBeanType(t0) ?
122                                                                    List.of(t0, d.javaLangObject().asType()) :
123                                                                    List.of())));
124    case BOOLEAN, BYTE, CHAR, DOUBLE, FLOAT, INT, LONG, SHORT ->
125      this.beanTypesCache.computeIfAbsent(t, t0 -> BeanTypeList.of(d,
126                                                                   List.of(t0, d.javaLangObject().asType())));
127    case DECLARED, TYPEVAR ->
128      this.beanTypesCache.computeIfAbsent(t, t0 -> BeanTypeList.of(d,
129                                                                   this.supertypes(t0, BeanTypes::legalBeanType)));
130    default ->
131      BeanTypeList.of(d, List.of());
132    };
133  }
134
135  /**
136   * Clears caches that may be used internally by this {@link BeanTypes}.
137   *
138   * @microbean.idempotency This method may clear internal state but otherwise has no side effects.
139   *
140   * @microbean.threadsafety This method is safe for concurrent use by multiple threads.
141   */
142  public final void clearCaches() {
143    this.beanTypesCache.clear();
144  }
145
146
147  /*
148   * Static methods.
149   */
150
151
152  /**
153   * Returns {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link TypeMirror} is a <dfn>legal bean type</dfn>.
154   *
155   * <p>Legal bean types are, exactly:</p>
156   *
157   * <ol>
158   *
159   * <li>{@linkplain TypeKind#ARRAY Array} types whose {@linkplain ArrayType#getComponentType() component type}s are
160   * legal bean types</li>
161   *
162   * <li>{@linkplain TypeKind#isPrimitive() Primitive} types</li>
163   *
164   * <li>{@linkplain TypeKind#DECLARED Declared} types that contain no {@linkplain TypeKind#WILDCARD wildcard type}s for
165   * every level of containment</li>
166   *
167   * </ol>
168   *
169   * @param t a {@link TypeMirror}; must not be {@code null}
170   *
171   * @return {@code true} if and only if {@code t} is a legal bean type; {@code false} otherwise
172   *
173   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code t} is {@code null}
174   *
175   * @microbean.idempotency This method is idempotent and deterministic.
176   *
177   * @microbean.threadsafety This method itself is safe for concurrent use by multiple threads, but {@link TypeMirror}
178   * implementations and {@link Domain} implementations may not be safe for such use.
179   */
180  public static final boolean legalBeanType(final TypeMirror t) {
181    // https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.0/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.0#assignable_parameters
182    // https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.0/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.0#legal_bean_types
183    return switch (t.getKind()) {
184
185    // "A bean type may be an array type."
186    //
187    // "However, some Java types are not legal bean types: [...] An array type whose component type is not a legal bean
188    // type"
189    case ARRAY -> {
190      if (!legalBeanType(((ArrayType)t).getComponentType())) { // note recursion
191        if (LOGGER.isLoggable(WARNING)) {
192          LOGGER.log(WARNING, t + " has a component type that is an illegal bean type (" + ((ArrayType)t).getComponentType() + ")");
193        }
194        yield false;
195      }
196      yield true;
197    }
198
199    // "A bean type may be a primitive type. Primitive types are considered to be identical to their corresponding
200    // wrapper types in java.lang."
201    case BOOLEAN, BYTE, CHAR, DOUBLE, FLOAT, INT, LONG, SHORT -> true;
202
203    // "A bean type may be a parameterized type with actual [see below] type parameters [arguments] and type variables."
204    //
205    // "However, some Java types are not legal bean types: [...] A parameterized type that contains [see below] a
206    // wildcard type parameter [argument] is not a legal bean type."
207    //
208    // Some ink has been spilled on what it means for a "parameterized" (generic) type to "contain" a "wildcard type
209    // parameter [argument]" (https://issues.redhat.com/browse/CDI-502). Because it turns out that "actual type"
210    // apparently means, among other things, a non-wildcard type, it follows that *no* wildcard type argument appearing
211    // *anywhere* in a bean type is permitted. Note that the definition of "actual type" does not appear in the CDI
212    // specification, but only in a closed JIRA issue
213    // (https://issues.redhat.com/browse/CDI-502?focusedId=13036118&page=com.atlassian.jira.plugin.system.issuetabpanels%3Acomment-tabpanel#comment-13036118).
214    //
215    // This still seems way overstrict to me but there you have it.
216    case DECLARED -> {
217      for (final TypeMirror ta : ((DeclaredType)t).getTypeArguments()) {
218        if (ta.getKind() != TypeKind.TYPEVAR && !legalBeanType(ta)) { // note recursion
219          if (LOGGER.isLoggable(WARNING)) {
220            LOGGER.log(WARNING, t + " has a type argument that is an illegal bean type (" + ta + ")");
221          }
222          yield false;
223        }
224      }
225      yield true;
226    }
227
228    // "A type variable is not a legal bean type." (Nothing else is either.)
229    default -> {
230      if (LOGGER.isLoggable(WARNING)) {
231        LOGGER.log(WARNING, t + " is an illegal bean type");
232      }
233      yield false;
234    }
235    };
236  }
237
238}
